Entities / Hcs Surety Layout

Uncertainty — Deck Layouts

Patrol cutter. 80 ft × 22 ft beam. Three decks. Built for boarding, not broadsides. Now sailing as the Uncertainty under private registry. Hull unchanged from HCS Surety; layout modifications noted per section. Grid scale: 5 ft per square. Hull length: 16 sq. Max beam: 4 sq (amidships), tapering to 2 sq at bow, 3 sq at stern.

Deck 1 — Weather Deck

Open. Full ship length. Night lighting: ship’s lanterns at bow, amidships, stern — dim light in cones, shadow patches between.

ZoneSizeContentsTactical
Foredeck15×15 ftBow swivel gun (360°), capstan, anchor hawse, spare line. Ram plate at waterline (Uncertainty refit).Capstan = hard cover; narrows to 2 sq at bow
Foremast Zone15×20 ftForemast (center), belaying pins both sides, rigging linesOpen, exposed; rigging climbable (DC 10 Athletics, action)
Port Cannon10×10 ft6-pounder on truck carriage (4×3 ft), cannon port in railHeavy cover; carriage can be rolled with DC 14 Athletics
Starboard Cannon10×10 ft6-pounder on truck carriage, cannon port in railAs port
Cargo Hatch10×10 ftIron-grate hatch (2×2 sq) to hold, rope and block overheadOpens to hold; can be dropped shut (action, DC 13 Str to force)
Mainmast Zone15×20 ftMainmast (center), main boom, rigging cleatsBoom can swing (DC 12 Str check, action): DC 13 Dex save or 1d8 bludgeoning, pushed 10 ft
Companionway Hatch5×5 ftLadder hatch, 1-sq opening, to gun deckChokepoint; one creature per turn to ascend/descend
Quarterdeck15×20 ftShip’s wheel, binnacle, speaking tube to chart tableRaised 2 ft (+5 ft movement to ascend); elevated attacks have advantage vs. deck-level targets
Stern Swivel5×10 ftSwivel gun (180° arc aft), stern rail. Signal lantern mounted on aft rail (Uncertainty refit).Point-blank canister shot: 3d6, 15-ft cone, DC 13 Dex half

New figurehead (Uncertainty refit): woman mid-stride, hands open, no expression. Carved hardwood. Above the waterline forward, above the ram plate.

Deck 2 — Gun Deck

Interior. ~65 ft × 14 ft usable. Overhead: 6 ft 4 in — Large creatures have disadvantage on attacks. Dim light from oil lamps unless extinguished. Accessed via companionway hatch (amidships) or aft stair (quarterdeck).

ZoneSizeContentsTactical
Crew Quarters20×14 ft6 hammock hooks, personal kit lockers, bilge hatchHammocks as soft cover; cramped, difficult terrain if hammocks down
Galley10×14 ftIron stove (fixed, hot), pot hooks, provisions cabinet, water barrelStove: shoved into it = 1d4 fire, DC 12 Dex save; barrel = improvised weapon
Weapons Locker15×14 ft8 boarding axes, 4 crossbows (20 bolts each), 6 grapple lines, 3 smoke grenades, 2 incendiary flasks, lockable chest. (Uncertainty refit: Crown gear replaced.)Bonus action to grab weapon from rack; priority loot target
Central Ladder5×10 ftLadder up to weather deck, down to hold; 2×2 landingChokepoint; one creature per turn each direction
Chart Table10×14 ftFixed chart table (bolted), Crown Islands survey charts (Admiralty markings scraped, Calveno notation overlaid), dividersBolted — cannot be flipped; provides cover
Surgeon’s Berth5×5 ft2 folding cots, suture kit, splinting materials, fever treatments. 3 Potions of Healing. (Uncertainty refit: alcove forward of officer cabin, replaces medic’s cabinet.)Wall-mounted, 1 sq; DC 10 Medicine for treatment without Surgeon hireling
Officer’s Cabin / Crew Mess10×10 ft(Uncertainty refit: converted to crew mess — bench seating for 6, folding table, cards and dominoes. Captain bunks forward with crew.)
Aft Stair5×5 ftCompanionway stair to quarterdeck; single-fileOne creature wide; attacker on stair has cover vs. below

Note on captain’s cabin: Cobb converted the officer cabin to crew mess without being directly asked. He received word via Mr. Thunk (“the captain sent him”). He does not editorialize.

Deck 3 — Hold

Lowest level. ~55 ft × 12 ft usable. Overhead: 5 ft 8 in — Medium creatures must crouch; disadvantage on attacks for anyone over 5’10”. No light. 6 in. standing bilge water at lowest point — difficult terrain. Accessed via cargo hatch (weather deck) or central ladder (gun deck).

ZoneSizeContentsTactical
Chain Locker10×10 ftAnchor chain in coiled piles1 creature at a time; difficult terrain; heavily cramped
Galley15×12 ft(Uncertainty refit: cast-iron stove on a sand bed, cook’s tools, bread locker — directly below crew mess, connected by iron ladder through hatch in the aft deck above.)Stove = fire hazard
Provisions Store15×12 ftSalt fish, rice, dried beans, fresh citrus, water casks ×4, small beer ×2 barrels, cooking oil. Emergency ration chest (sealed). (Uncertainty refit: occupies former brig space and adjacent stores.)Barrels = cover and improvised weapons
Inspection Storage10×12 ft(Original: inspection manifests, blank Crown writs. Now largely cleared.)
General Cargo15×12 ftParty cargo and stored items
Powder Magazine10×12 ft12 cannon charges (sealed copper), 20 pistol chargesFire hazard: open flame within 10 ft = DC 12 Dex save or 8d6 fire (20-ft radius), hull takes 30 damage
Bilge Pump5×5 ftManual pump; requires action to operateBilge water pools: DC 10 Acrobatics or prone if running

Prisoner brig (decommissioned): Cage bolts cut; iron repurposed for the ram plate fitting. Space absorbed into Provisions Store.

Bastion Slot Mapping

4 facility berths at Tier 1. All 4 installed (Uncertainty refit, Nona’s account).
